texts: When mire-essence forms in the cauldron, the Keepers store the mire-essence in clay vessels.
Whenever mire-essence forms in the cauldron, the Keepers keep the mire-essence in clay vessels.
Each Keeper draws stored mire-essence when that Keeper tends a lantern.
Stored mire-essence will feed lantern lighting.

fields.sentence: When mire-essence forms in the cauldron, the Keepers store the mire-essence in clay vessels.
parse: (: mire_form_store (Implication (And (Member $x form) (Patient $x $m) (Member $m mire_essence) (Location $x sk_cauldron_1)) (And (Member (sk_store $x) store) (Agent (sk_store $x) sk_keepers_1) (Theme (sk_store $x) $m) (Location (sk_store $x) clay_vessel) (During (sk_store $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "the Keepers" is a capitalized plural kind-word label, which the instruction set makes a Name-only individual (one symbol plus a Name atom, no GroupOf and no per-member kind from the label word), but the parse emits (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) and no Name atom.

"in clay vessels" fills the consequent's Location slot with the bare kind symbol clay_vessel rather than a per-occurrence witness/group, so each storing event is located at a kind instead of at vessels, unlike the indefinite-in-a-rule-conclusion Skolem pattern.

review.notes: The bare "when P, Q" routing onto the whenever rule machinery, the mire_essence/clay_vessel genus decompositions with the noun modifiers left unexposed, the During link to the trigger, the top-level-asserted sk_cauldron_1 constant in the premise, and the 1.0/0.9 rule TV all follow the instruction set.

issues.reason: Names and casing makes a capitalized plural kind-word label referring as a name ('the Keepers') a Name-only individual — one symbol plus a Name atom, no GroupOf and no per-member kind invented from the label word — so (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) with no Name atom violates the stated rule.

A non-specific filler may stay a bare kind (the 'pays tax' / 'grows wheat' licence, and the oblique-object rule's bare-constant branch), while the Skolem-function pattern is stated only for marked dependent existentials ('some/a N', a numeral), so the bare-kind Location is a licensed choice — or at worst graceful improvisation with true, well-typed atoms.

new_gaps: A bare-plural count oblique in a generic rule's conclusion ('in clay vessels'): bare-kind filler vs per-occurrence witness/group is unspecified — the episodic group-witness split is stated for clauses, the Skolem-function pattern only for marked indefinites.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 1: the compliant form is a Name-only individual — e.g. symbol keepers with (Name keepers "Keepers") filling the rule's Agent slot — with no GroupOf and no keeper type atom.
adjudication.notes: The when-clause routing onto the whenever machinery, the per-occurrence variable for the forming essence reused by the anaphoric definite, the During link, the top-level cauldron constant in the premise, and the decompositions are all per spec.

fields.sentence: Whenever mire-essence forms in the cauldron, the Keepers keep the mire-essence in clay vessels.
parse: (: whenever_form_keep (Implication (And (Member $x form) (Patient $x mire_essence) (Location $x sk_cauldron_1)) (And (Member (sk_keep $x) keep) (Agent (sk_keep $x) sk_keepers_1) (Theme (sk_keep $x) mire_essence) (Location (sk_keep $x) clay_vessel) (During (sk_keep $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "the Keepers" is a capitalized plural kind-word label, which Names and casing makes a Name-only individual (one symbol + Name atom, no GroupOf and no per-member kind from the label word), but the parse emits (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) and no Name atom.

q2_gaps: a bare mass-noun participant inside the whenever/every-time rule ("mire-essence forms") - the instruction set does not say whether it becomes a per-occurrence Skolem entity or stays the bare kind symbol, and so leaves the consequent's anaphoric definite "the mire-essence" with no witness to reuse

a bare-plural oblique object inside a rule conclusion ("in clay vessels") - the bare-kind-filler vs group-witness split is stated for episodic clauses only, so the per-binding form inside a generic rule is unspecified
review.notes: The whenever machinery is otherwise applied correctly: event-domain Implication with a Skolem-function response, During link to the trigger, no QuantifierPhrase, STV 1.0 0.9, Location on the keep event only (no LocatedIn on the essence), and mire_essence / clay_vessel decomposed with genus only (noun modifiers not exposed).

issues.reason: Names and casing makes a capitalized plural kind-word label referring as a name ('the Keepers') a Name-only individual — one symbol plus a Name atom, no GroupOf and no per-member kind invented from the label word — so (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) with no Name atom violates the stated rule.

gaps_confirmed: Bare mass participant inside a whenever rule ('mire-essence forms'): per-occurrence variable/witness vs bare kind constant is unspecified, leaving the consequent's anaphoric definite 'the mire-essence' with no witness to reuse.

Bare-plural oblique inside a rule conclusion ('in clay vessels'): the group-witness vs bare-kind split is stated for episodic clauses only, so the per-binding form inside a generic rule is unspecified.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 1: the compliant form is a Name-only individual — e.g. symbol keepers with (Name keepers "Keepers") filling the rule's Agent slot — with no GroupOf and no keeper type atom.
adjudication.notes: Within the two confirmed gaps the bare-kind mire_essence and clay_vessel fillers are acceptable improvisation (true, well-typed, nothing over-asserted); the whenever machinery, During link, and TVs are otherwise per spec.

fields.sentence: Each Keeper draws stored mire-essence when that Keeper tends a lantern.
parse: (: keeper_draw_rule (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $t tend) (Agent $t $k) (Theme $t $ln) (Member $ln lantern)) (And (Member (sk_draw $t) draw) (Agent (sk_draw $t) $k) (Theme (sk_draw $t) stored_mire_essence) (During (sk_draw $t) $t))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "stored mire-essence" is fused into the compound kind `stored_mire_essence` with an exposed modifier genus, but `stored` is a participle used as a modifier and an incidental state descriptor, which the adjective+noun fusion test ("never for incidental description") and the "a laminated worktop" precedent both send to a separate property atom rather than a fused compound.

q2_gaps: an adjectivally/participially modified bare mass or kind object sitting in a non-specific role slot ("draws stored mire-essence"): the never-fuse branch of the adjective+noun test prescribes a two-atom split, but a bare kind filler supplies no witness to carry the second atom, so no encoding is specified
review.notes: Rule routing is right: "when that Keeper tends a lantern" with generic participants takes the whenever machinery, the donkey-style rebinding of "that Keeper" to $k is correct, and the "each" QuantifierPhrase companion, rule strengths and Skolem-function event are all per spec. `Theme` for "tends a lantern" is the licensed unclear-case default.

issues.reason: 'stored' is a participial state descriptor, not a term-of-art / origin / role-title / material-adjective pairing, so the adjective+noun fusion test ('never for incidental description') and the laminated-worktop precedent bar the fusion and its definitional decomposition atoms — the modifier belongs on a bearer as a separate property atom.

gaps_confirmed: A participially/adjectivally restricted bare mass or kind object in a non-specific role slot ('draws stored mire-essence'): the never-fuse branch demands a two-atom split, but no rule supplies the witness to carry the second atom inside a rule conclusion.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 1: the compliant direction is an unfused per-occurrence bearer in the conclusion — e.g. (Theme (sk_draw $t) (sk_essence $t)) with (Member (sk_essence $t) mire_essence) and (Member (sk_essence $t) stored) — but no rule squarely licenses minting that witness for a bare mass filler; that missing licence is exactly the confirmed gap.
adjudication.notes: The rest is per spec: the when-clause takes the whenever machinery, 'that Keeper' rebinds to $k donkey-style, the 'each' QuantifierPhrase and 1.0/0.9 TV are right, and capitalized singular 'Keeper' correctly stays a common-noun kind by the singular-label default.

fields.sentence: Stored mire-essence will feed lantern lighting.

q1_issues.issue: The finite "will" is dropped -- the consequent carries no (Future (sk_feed $x)) status atom, so a future claim is recorded as a tenseless habitual.

q2_gaps: a future-tense ("will") claim over a bare mass/kind subject: the distributing-rule route is specified for genuinely generic clauses (habitual present, characteristic claim), and the instruction set does not say whether a "will" generic takes the rule at all, nor whether Future rides its consequent
review.notes: Compound handling is right (mire_essence/lantern_lighting genus only, no noun-modifier genus) and the "stored" restriction correctly becomes a premise conjunct rather than fusing into the kind. Patient on "feed" is arguable but defensible.

issues.reason: Finite 'will' is carried as (Future e), and the universal-rule examples put tense inside the Skolem consequent ('(Past (sk_pass $x))'), so omitting (Future (sk_feed $x)) silently drops a stated marker and widens a future claim into a timeless habitual — a qualifier is never silently dropped.

gaps_confirmed: A future-tense 'will' claim over a bare kind subject: the distributing-rule route is specified for habitual-present / characteristic generics, and nothing legislates whether a 'will' claim is a generic taking the rule (versus a specific future episode on a witness) or how Future rides the consequent.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 1: the compliant form keeps the parse's rule and adds (Future (sk_feed $x)) inside the consequent bundle, per the tense-inside-consequent mechanics of the universal-rule examples.
adjudication.notes: The rule route itself is forced here — an adjectivally-restricted kind subject bars the kind-relation form — and the 'stored' restriction correctly lands as a premise conjunct rather than fusing; strength 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase matches a bare generic.
